'''Magical Pokémon Journey: The Pokémon-Watcher's Diary''' is the tenth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the 15th and 16th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|3}}.
==Blurb==
'''''ABRACADABRA!'''''

''Almond is writing a spy book documenting all his sightings of Pokemon! But he shouldn't have shown it to his Pokemon friends, because now they all want to help!'' 

''Then Walnut the ninja joins our heroes in picking sweet potatoes, but while picking a peck of potatoes they find themselves picked...by Abra?!''
